intro: We hold a recorded total fee for {{count}} published Diploma - UG colleges in India. This short list is the current set of top Diploma - UG colleges in India with fees for 2026 in our records, not a complete map of diploma campuses.
Because the list is so small, treat it as a starting point. Confirm each fee, duration and approval on the official college or board notice before you apply.
listLead: The three cards are MB Patel Science College, Anand; the College of Engineering, Pathanapuram; and Lamrin Tech Skill University. Two of the programmes are in medical laboratory technology, and one is a diploma in electrical and electronics engineering.
snapshot: All {{published}} colleges on this page have a published profile: {{private}} private and {{public}} public. They sit in Gujarat, Kerala and Punjab.
We have not quoted a fee median here, because the automatic table hides medians when fewer than five colleges have a fee. The three recorded fees should be read one by one on the official notice.
firstCollegesLead: In our records, the Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology at MB Patel Science College is ₹24,000 for two years, and the DMLT at Lamrin Tech Skill University is ₹60,000 for two years.
The College of Engineering, Pathanapuram, has a recorded diploma fee of ₹54,000 for three years in electrical and electronics engineering. None of the three cards has a placement year in our table.

compare.heading: How to compare the top Diploma - UG colleges in India with fees
paragraphs: With only {{count}} colleges here, the useful comparison is between the specific diplomas, not between a national ranking of diploma campuses.
bullets: Whether the diploma is in laboratory technology or engineering, and whether it is a two-year or three-year course.
The approval or affiliation on the official notice, and whether the fee is for the full programme.
That this page does not yet include the wider set of polytechnic and UG diploma colleges in India.

faqs.question: How many UG diploma colleges have fees listed here?
faqs.answer: Only {{count}} published Diploma - UG colleges currently have a recorded total fee in this list. That is a small, incomplete set, so the real number of diploma colleges in India is much higher.

faqs.question: Which colleges appear on this UG diploma fee list?
faqs.answer: MB Patel Science College, Anand, with a recorded DMLT fee of ₹24,000; the College of Engineering, Pathanapuram, with a recorded diploma fee of ₹54,000; and Lamrin Tech Skill University, with a recorded DMLT fee of ₹60,000.

faqs.question: Are these fees for the full diploma?
faqs.answer: In our records the first and third programmes are listed as two-year courses, and the Pathanapuram diploma as three years. Confirm the period and any extra charges on the official fee notice.

faqs.question: Why is this list so short?
faqs.answer: A fee list can only include published colleges with a quotable total fee on file. Many diploma and polytechnic campuses are therefore missing until we hold a usable fee for them.
